text: This guide explains how to get an appointment at theBürgeramtin Berlin.

You don’t need to go to the Bürgeramt. How to do your Anmeldung online How to do your Abmeldung online

Choose a service in thelist of services. For example, for theAnmeldungor theAbmeldung. Scroll to the list of locations, and select all locations. You can go to anyBürgeramtin Berlin, not just the one near you. You can’t go to aBürgeramtinBrandenburg. Choose an appointment date. Receive a verification code by email. You have 10 minutes to enter the activation code. If you don’t get an email, try again with a different email address.7 Enter the verification code in the appointment booking page. Get an appointment confirmation.

title: If there are no appointments
text: Sometimes, there are no appointments available. Try again every few minutes. Most new appointments appear during working hours. There are more appointments in the morning, between 8:00 and 11:00.1Look for appointments everywhere in Berlin, not just near you. The Bürgeramt does not release all available appointments online. Some appointments are only for people who call115. Other appointments are only given by Bürgeramt employees.2

title: Multiple services, one appointment
text: You can book a single appointment for multiple services: Select aBürgeramtfrom thelist ofBürgeramtlocations Scroll to the list of services. Select multiple services Click “An diesem Standort einen Termin buchen”.

section: Other ways to get an appointment
title: Call 115
text: Call115between 7:00 and 18:00.3This is theBürgertelefon. They can find you aBürgeramtappointment, even when there are no appointments online.2 They only speak German. You must wait a few minutes to talk to someone.

section: Other ways to get an appointment
title: Email the Bürgeramt
text: Email your localBürgeramt, explain what you need, and ask for an appointment. If your situation is urgent, include a proof. You might get an appointment faster, even if there are no appointments online.4They usually reply in 1 or 2 days. How to contact the Bürgeramt

section: Other ways to get an appointment
title: Go to the Bürgeramt in person
text: If your situation is urgent, you can go to theBürgeramtin person. They will help you on the same day, or give you an emergency appointment. For example, if you need documents to travel soon, you can go in person.6 If your situation is not urgent, ask for an appointment by email. It’s faster.5
If you can’t go to your appointment, cancel it. In your confirmation email, there is a link to cancel your appointment. Click the link, and cancel your appointment.

Many Bürgeramt employees only speak German. If you don’t speak German, bring a translator or a German-speaking friend. I recommendRed Tape Translation. Appointments for theAnmeldungand theAbmeldungare simple, so you probably don’t need a translator. If you sign aVollmacht, someone can go to theBürgeramtfor you.Red Tape Translationcan do it. It’s expensive, but it saves time.

If you have a problem, email the Bürgeramt. They usually reply a few days later. Sometimes it takes a few weeks.
